public_health_question.v: What was the source of a large community Legionnaires disease outbreak in Napa, California, in 2022, and how was it controlled?

ev.q: linked one Legionella sequence type to a cooling tower and two cases. Mapping facilitated targeted sampling and remediation.
Large Community Outbreak of Legionnaires Disease Potentially Associated with a Cooling Tower
The investigation response to this community outbreak illustrates the importance of interdisciplinary collaboration by public health agencies
Napa County Public Health (NCPH) in California received reports of three positive urinary antigen tests
Interviews with patients or their proxies revealed that 14 patients lived in downtown Napa
Public health investigators collected environmental samples from 11 potential sources.
